title: The personal feed pane shows a bounded tail of the channel
intention: cairn/tools/base/shim.py _personal_feed_pane renders at most the newest FEED_PANE_LIMIT (200) messages of a device's personal channel, newest last, preceded by one line naming how many older messages exist and the command that reads them all; it never reads the whole channel to do so.
why: Akien 2026-10-10: "to the best of your ability, get it all closed", pre-approved through PROVED. This ticket closes live trouble /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/chat-pane-is-unbounded.json, a measured fault that enters as a bug (skills/intent/SKILL.md: a bug enters as a ticket, not through /intent). Measured 2026-10-02: GET /device/cairn = 428,192,484 bytes, 434 MB under <h2>Chat. Re-measured 2026-10-10 by cc0: 1,448,295,623 bytes in 47.1s (curl to http://localhost/device/cairn), and the web server held 1.17 GB RSS afterwards; the builder's background rehearsal was killed for low memory the same hour.
traces_to: Law 7 (a presentation surface may collapse into a coherent shape; an unbounded one is no surface at all); CP4 (the device page is for a reader, and nobody reads 1.4 GB).
how: cairn/tools/base only. In shim.py _personal_feed_pane (~:578 region; find it by name): (1) module constant FEED_PANE_LIMIT = 200; (2) ask the bus/store for the newest N (if the read API has no limit argument, read through it but slice before rendering, and say so in a comment naming the debt); (3) render 'N older messages not shown — <cli command that lists the channel>' when older exist. No receipt filtering change. Keep the pane's existing HTML shape.
falsifier: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_feed_pane_is_bounded.py under PROVES {'a43109013780': {'1','2'}}, over a fixture shim with an injected channel of 1,000 messages: (1) the rendered pane carries exactly FEED_PANE_LIMIT message entries, the newest ones, newest last; (2) it carries the line naming 800 older messages; with 5 messages there is no such line and all 5 show. Hollow: removing the slice reds 1. Live check in the verdict: GET /device/cairn under 5 MB.
watchme: none, because the fault is measured at /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/chat-pane-is-unbounded.json and the trouble clears with a measured what_changed when this ticket is PROVED; a recurrence re-raises the same identity
intent_berth: none, because this is a bug entering as a ticket (skills/intent/SKILL.md, the TICKET entry point), born from the measured fault at /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/chat-pane-is-unbounded.json

decisions.text: Limit 200, newest last, a count line for the rest: the smallest bound that keeps a working conversation visible. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

builder_notes: WHERE: cairn/tools/base/shim.py def _personal_feed_pane. Do NOT GET /device/cairn on the live server before this lands: it is 1.4 GB. Restart the web server after (cairn restart path, not a hand kill).
